arguments.assumptions: Hypothetical FY2026 US-GAAP diluted EPS stress grid, not consensus. H1 reported GAAP diluted EPS is $1.75. Bear/base/bull FY EPS of $3.35/$3.65/$3.95 imply H2 residual GAAP EPS of $1.60/$1.90/$2.20 under a constant-share approximation; actual diluted shares and GAAP/non-GAAP exclusions can change. Management's Q3 guide is non-GAAP diluted EPS $1.06-$1.08 and cannot be added directly to GAAP H1 EPS. Bear tests weaker AI/customer deployment timing, acceptance delays and/or margin pressure; base assumes Q3 demand and margins broadly track management's non-GAAP outlook while GAAP exclusions remain manageable; bull tests stronger AI Ethernet shipments and operating leverage. P/E assumptions of 40x/50x/60x deliberately stress valuation compression versus durable premium growth; they are not observed, fair, normal, or probability-weighted multiples.

cases.rationale: H2 GAAP residual $1.60; tests customer timing, acceptance/supply friction and margin pressure, plus multiple compression.
H2 GAAP residual $1.90; assumes execution directionally consistent with Q3 non-GAAP guide while preserving the accounting-basis distinction.
H2 GAAP residual $2.20; tests AI Ethernet shipment upside, better operating leverage and sustained premium multiple.
